items.title: Cursor agents can now control your computer via Computer Use to drive desktop apps
facts: Cursor announced that agents can drive desktop apps like the iOS Simulator to test the features they build.
Computer Use lets agents click and type across any app on your computer, not just the browser.
Cursor uses it on its own when a task needs it; users can also request it by @-mentioning Computer Use in the prompt.
Users can try it by updating Cursor.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.310 adds Monitor tool support and gateway fixes
facts: Added the Monitor tool and plugin monitors on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry or nonessential traffic is disabled; long foreground sleeps are now blocked there too.
Fixed requests failing behind some gateways and compatible servers that reject the effort-2025-11-24 beta value or mid-conversation system messages; Claude Code now retries without them.
Fixed background cleanup deleting some recent files, such as pasted images, when cleanupPeriodDays is set to a very large value.
Other fixes include compaction handling, permission prompts, Windows hooks, and cloud session improvements.

items.title: Moonshot launches Kimi K3.1 Pro model with strong Terminal-Bench coding performance
facts: Kimi K3.1 Pro is a post-trained version of K3, a 2.8T-total / 104B-active MoE with 1M-token context, available now on Kimi.ai, Kimi Code, and the API.
It scores 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 (ahead of GPT-6 Astra 58.2%, behind Claude Opus 5.5 66.4%) and 61.2% on internal Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon.
API pricing is $2 input / $10 output per million tokens; full weights promised by Nov 4, 2026.
Cyber-related data was removed from mid-training and RL for the open-weight release.

items.title: GitHub Copilot usage metrics API now includes usage from external tools like OpenCode
facts: The Copilot usage metrics API now reports model usage from more tools, including OpenCode, via a new totals_by_client array in enterprise and organization reports.
Each entry includes client name (e.g., opencode, claude_code, codex), request_count, session_count, token_usage, and totals_by_model.
This closes the gap for tools that use Copilot as a model provider but do not send editor telemetry.
Available for 1-day and 28-day reports to owners and those with View Copilot Metrics permission.
items.reaction: Teams using mixed agent stacks noted improved visibility into Copilot consumption across CLI and other clients.

items.title: GitHub Copilot in Microsoft Teams can turn notifications into code changes
facts: The new GitHub app in Microsoft Teams brings repository notifications and GitHub Copilot together so teams can turn updates into action.
Reply to a notification and @mention GitHub with a task; Copilot can reproduce bugs, run tests, implement fixes, and prepare a pull request.
Requires a paid Copilot plan and cloud sandboxes; notifications themselves do not require a license.
Previously called GitHub notifications; existing users should update the app.
items.reaction: Developers saw it as a way to act on issues directly from chat without context switching.
